nodes.summary: Personal projects only — runs entirely on the local computer
nodes.detail: All generated projects are personal-use software. They execute only on the user's local machine with minimal infrastructure. No cloud services, no deployment pipelines, no remote dependencies, no multi-user concerns.

nodes.summary: Simplicity is the core rule — fewer lines of code wins
nodes.detail: Simplify the process and the code. When two designs work, choose the one with fewer lines and less machinery. Brevity is the primary quality metric; complexity must justify itself or be deleted.
Auto-explaining code: clear names, small functions, obvious structure. The code should read like documentation without needing separate docs; add comments only where logic is genuinely non-obvious.
Use Python for personal projects by default. Prefer stdlib over external dependencies; keep dependency lists minimal or empty.
